notes.title: Super Saurio Fly: Jurassic Edition NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32333932/7a9eefff3fc35680baddd6f31f44c86b8b1db9fe.jpg[/img]

What’s up everyone? Our “Super Saurio Fly: Jurassic Edition” Update is finally here! Sauria has joined the fight as a new playable character in singleplayer and local co-op! By popular demand, we’ve also added an extra difficulty level, achievements and some quality of life improvements!

We sincerely hope you all have a fun Jurassic time with our free update. <3

The full nitty-gritty patch notes can be found in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791461855340/announcements/detail/1748988727385092966]this earlier post.[/url]

notes.title: Super Saurio Fly: Jurassic Edition COMING SOON
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32333932/20a43e06e6bd42df6e8666415ea2a9771eb46db7.gif[/img]

Hey Folks! Our “Super Saurio Fly: Jurassic Edition” we’ve been teasing you with is just around the corner! So we figured we should share some of the things you can expect to see in your game if you launch Super Saurio Fly after the Jurassic Edition patch lands. Hope you have a second controller lying around! :)

[list][*]For this patch, we’re adding local co-op in the form of a second player: Sauria!

[*]Sauria has the same mechanics as Saurio, but has a very different weapon, as well as being stronger when it comes to melee attacks due to her higher attack speed.

[*]Her Projectiles are hammers she throws in an arc, depending on what Chili she ate, her weapon type will change accordingly.

[*]Inside the game you’ll be able to switch from Saurio to Sauria by pressing “X” on the gamepad. If a second gamepad is paired and the second player presses “X”, the player will enter the game and local co-op will be enabled.

[*]Hearts and Energy are link to a character, not to the gamepad, so if a player 1 is using Saurio, takes some damage, switches to Sauria, and in that moment a second player choses Saurio, the damage it took earlier will still be there.

[*]Player 1 will still be the main character, player 2 will merely assist on player 1’s quest of getting back the stolen eggs.

[*]If player 1 dies, we’ll go back to the last checkpoint, if player 2 dies, the player would just have to wait a bit before jumping back to the action.

[*]Both players share the same life pool. If they’re not enough lives left, player 2 will be unable to join.

[*]We’ve reworked the animations and optimized the textures to bring down the overall size of the game. The results are better graphics and more internal space for other games to boot!

[*]We’ve revised and optimized the scripts of the game for a better gaming experience.

notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The summer is here! And everyone knows with summer comes heat, palm trees and fighting against evil oviraptors that want to turn your family into an omelet! We hope you have a great summer and enjoy the adventure!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2 - "Those bugs we were surprise you found"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32333932/18082c5a330e8fe27f6b7b99c7be94f971e8bb95.jpg[/img]
Hi Gamers!! 

How is everything going?

We are happy to announce that we are hearing all your feedback and with that we have come with a new Patch that improves the game in several points!!

The most important are:
 - We have put a small tutorial in the begging so you can understand all the controls!
 - We have improved the movement of Saurio to give you a better game experience!
 - We have fixed a bug that happened with the videos. After several tests we did not find any more bugs! We challenge you to find some more!! 

We want to take this opportunity to thank again all the support from the community! Thanks to you we are improving every minute :)

notes.title: Hi and welcome to Super Saurio Fly.
notes.content:
We are FraxelGames and this is our first project! We are an indie videogame company, based in Malaga.

After one intense year of hard work we are able to finally bring you this amazing platformer!

You will have the possibility to play with Saurio, a little Pterodactyl whose eggs have been stolen. 

Saurio will have to go through 16 different levels while using the entire arsenal he has. Each level will dispose of a unique ambience and numerous details and secrets.

The game will come in different difficulty levels, allowing each type of gamer to enjoy the experience to its fullest. The variable difficulty curve of the game is one the strongest attractions of the “Super Saurio Fly”.

Feel free to follow us on facebook, Twitter and Instagram for more information!
